title: My MallWorld experience
content: I've had MallWorld dreams for many years. The mall isn't anything too crazy. Just a food court and generic storefronts. I don't recall ever going into any of the stores in my dreams though. The inside is kind of a mix of a mall and the store/foodcourt areas inside of an international airport. The mall is pretty "modern" looking and is very clean and all the walls are white. It honestly looks like the inside of a space station or something in a sci-fi movie. Most of the "narratives" of my dreams is basically me rushing around the mall completing "tasks" trying to find specific people or order food from a restaurant but something always goes wrong. For example I might stand in line at to order Chick-fil-a or something but when I finally get up to order I realize I don't have my wallet on me. It's also worth noting these dreams are not lucid (expect for one specific exception but I'll get to that). There's also very frequently social conflict aspects to my dreams as well. All or most of the people in my dreams are people I know in real life. Sometimes the "tasks" I have to accomplish leads to conflict with these people. For example that food ordering scenario might be me having to order food for a friend who is shopping in a store and that friend has given me money to go order them food. I might, for example, end up losing the food and have to go find that friend and explain that I basically wasted their money. But the dreams also are not simple or linear and often multiple "tasks" are occurring simultaneously and I get interrupted and something always always always goes wrong. To continue with this example I might be looking for this friend and not be able to find them. On top of this someone might come up to me and tell me to go tell someone else something and I basically get a sidequest in the dream. The biggest thing about these dreams is that there is way too much going on and it gets to be extremely stressful. I will say in real life I do have anxiety problems sometimes and these dreams are probably an extreme expression of that. I have had these dreams somewhat frequently over the over. Not every night, not every week, but often enough that I can't forget about it. Other than this there is another type of repeated dream that lasted for years. I haven't had this dream in year though. It really wasn't a repeated dream it was just a repeated location of being in an arcade with older arcade cabinets (no specific game) and dim blue lighting. It's a small arcade. That's it. Pretty simple but this is the earliest dream I can ever remember happening. This dream happened to me very frequently I would say between the ages of 4 - 8 years old. Like at times once a week. It was so prominent that some of these dreams I thought were real memories but when I asked my mother about it she denied us ever going to anywhere like this. I also don't think this was a real place I've ever been but that's how prominent this was in my childhood. In contrast with the extreme stress of the mall dream the arcade is incredibly peaceful and feels like home. I'm always alone in these dreams except for one exception where I was with my sister. It's also worth mentioning that I didn't really hang out in arcades much as a child so I don't know where this stemmed from. I hadn't had this dream for many years until one night I had a MallWorld dream. I was walking around doing whatever "task" I had when I stumbled upon a storefront and upon peering in I was greeted by that familiar dim blue light. It was the same arcade. This was such a shock that I became aware I was dreaming and was shocked about how these two repeating dreams seemed to converge. The only thing that was off about the arcade in this dream was that the calm feeling I normally felt was absent. It felt so wrong and although it looked the same something about the "energy" in the arcade felt dark and ominous. The dim lights seemed foreboding. I have never had the arcade dream again since then. My last experience ever set in this arcade that was a comforting staple of my childhood dreams was infected by the stressful environment of the MallWorld. If anyone has any similar experience I'd love to hear it. Does anyone have any thought about my experiences?
